name: Collapsing Floor
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-01: The Absalom Initiation
description: Around the edges of the pit, more rotting boards are ready to give way.
reset: As the damage to the floor spreads, the areas adjacent to the new pit become new areas of this hazard.

generalAbilities.name: Pitfall
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature walks next to the pit.

Effect The triggering creature falls in and takes falling damage (typically 3 Bludgeoning Damage damage) plus 4d6 Piercing Damage damage from landing on broken boards.

That creature can attempt to Grab an Edge to avoid falling; the DC to Climb the walls or Grab an Edge is 18.
